$Comment: The first find tier, reached from cycle 10 of a session. It pays OFFCUTS only - one pull from the shared RPG_Station_Sawmill_Byproducts list and nothing else - so the earliest finds are the everyday material a working bench produces rather than anything precious. Life essence starts at the second tier, which is what makes reaching it feel like a step up rather than more of the same. The Multiple container resolves every child, so adding a second reference to the byproduct list here would simply double the offcuts without touching their mix.
